outputs.explanation: Panel a shows a schematic and micrographs illustrating image cropping/rotation, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows schematic drawings and micrographs illustrating image spacing, not a quantitative plot.
Panel c shows a schematic and micrographs illustrating insets/zoom, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel d shows a series of micrographs at different brightness/contrast settings, not a data plot.
Panel e shows schematic color circles and micrographs illustrating channel annotation, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel f shows schematic overlap diagrams and micrographs in grayscale, not a quantitative plot.
Panel g shows micrographs with calibration/intensity color scale bars, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
